title: DNA Wrapping by a Tetrameric Bacterial Histone
authors: Hu Y; Schwab S; Qiu K; Zhang Y; Bär K; Reichle H; Panzera A; Lupas AN; Hartmann MD; Dame RT; Alva V; Alvarez BH
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌组蛋白HLp四聚体包裹DNA的结构与动态机制，通过晶体学、分子动力学模拟和DNA结合实验揭示非特异性蛋白-DNA互作模式，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA包裹建模与MD方法可迁移至转录因子结合机制研究。
abstract: Histones are conserved DNA-packaging proteins found across all domains of life. In eukaryotes, canonical histones form octamers that wrap ∼147 base pairs of DNA into nucleosomes — the fundamental units of chromatin. In archaea, histones form dimers that further multimerize into extended hypernucleosomes along DNA. Although bacteria were long thought to lack histones, recent studies have uncovered histone homologs in diverse bacterial lineages, many of which possess key DNA-binding features. We previously characterized HBb, a bacterial histone from Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus , which binds DNA as a dimer and induces bending. Here, we describe HLp from Leptospira perolatii , a representative of a distinct bacterial histone group. Crystallographic and biophysical analyses reveal that HLp forms stable tetramers. Like HBb, HLp binds DNA non-specifically; however, it adopts a different mode of interaction — wrapping ∼60 base pairs of DNA around its tetrameric core. This wrapping mode, supported by molecular dynamics simulations and DNA-binding assays, promotes DNA compaction and alters its topology. When expressed heterologously in Escherichia coli , HLp reorganizes nucleoid morphology, consistent with a role in chromatin organization. These findings expand the known repertoire of histone-DNA interaction in bacteria and underscore the structural and functional diversity of histone-based genome organization across the tree of life.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白是存在于所有生命域中的保守DNA包装蛋白。在真核生物中，典型组蛋白形成八聚体，将约147碱基对的DNA包裹成核小体——染色质的基本单位。在古菌中，组蛋白形成二聚体，并进一步多聚化，沿DNA延伸形成超核小体。尽管细菌长期以来被认为缺乏组蛋白，但近期研究已在多种细菌谱系中发现了组蛋白同源物，其中许多具有关键的DNA结合特征。我们此前表征了来自Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus的细菌组蛋白HBb，它以二聚体形式结合DNA并诱导弯曲。在此，我们描述了来自Leptospira perolatii的HLp，这是一个独特细菌组蛋白群的代表。晶体学和生物物理分析揭示，HLp形成稳定的四聚体。与HBb类似，HLp非特异性地结合DNA；然而，它采用不同的相互作用模式——将其四聚体核心周围约60碱基对的DNA包裹起来。这种包裹模式，得到分子动力学模拟和DNA结合实验的支持，促进DNA压缩并改变其拓扑结构。当在大肠杆菌中异源表达时，HLp重组核样体形态，与染色质组织中的功能一致。这些发现扩展了细菌中组蛋白-DNA相互作用的已知谱系，并强调了基于组蛋白的基因组组织在生命之树中的结构和功能多样性。
